text.inline:
I found the issue! The `page_count` function on line 8 uses integer division (`//`), which gives 2 for `21 // 10`, but it should give 3 because you need 3 pages to show 21 items (10 + 10 + 1).

The fix is to use ceiling division. Let me fix this:

text.inline: The test now passes. The fix was to implement ceiling division in `page_count` by changing `total_items // per_page` to `(total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page`, which correctly calculates that 21 items with 10 per page requires 3 pages (2 full pages + 1 partial page).
